subject: diplomatic-appointments-lqa
note: 4A, 2026-10-02. Diplomatic Appointments (Selection Process) Bill 2026, first reading print (Senate), 7 September 2026. One module per Part; Part 3 is imported by Part 2 because s 10 reads the Selection Committee s 12 creates. The boundary modules the reference register names (boundary/aia-time.l4, boundary/mops-1984.l4, boundary/psa-1999-s39.l4) exist at those paths and as byte-identical copies in the subject folder, which the Part modules import: the installed l4 cannot import from another folder (ENCODING-NOTES.md, E-01). cases.l4 holds every #ASSERT (227, all satisfied).

provisions: s 6 ('Minister', 'Secretary'; the signpost definitions where they bite)

not_encoded.reason: approved scope ('out'): a simplified outline is not intended to be operative (OPC Drafting Direction 1.3A). Read and kept as text; its sentence that a recommended person 'must be appointed' is the other reading of FORK-09.

not_encoded.provisions: s 2(2), column 3 of the s 2(1) table, the note to s 2(1), the note to s 10(7), the table of contents and the long title
not_encoded.reason: approved scope ('out'): not part of the operative law (s 2(2) for column 3); the notes are read for categories X and F, not encoded. The s 10(7) note is quoted in part2-selection.l4 beside FORK-04.

not_encoded.provisions: the content of rules under s 16, and which offices are prescribed under s 7(2)
not_encoded.reason: approved scope ('out'): no rules have been made; whether an office is prescribed is an input to s 7(2), and s 16 is encoded only as the limit on what rules may provide.

not_encoded.provisions: s 12(6) (matters the rules may provide for) and s 12(7) (instruments under s 12(1) and (4) not legislative instruments)
not_encoded.reason: nothing to decide: no rules exist (REF-06), and s 12(7) is declaratory (REF-28). Quoted in part3-committees.l4 without a rule.

not_encoded.provisions: s 10(4) (Committee may seek assistance, input or information)
not_encoded.reason: a permission with no condition and no consequence; nothing to decide. Quoted in part2-selection.l4, and read in FORK-06 reading B.

not_encoded.provisions: the State and Territory staff and legislature-membership laws behind s 8(1), (2)(a) and (c)
not_encoded.reason: approved scope ('out'): eight jurisdictions' laws; membership, and State or Territory staff employment with a corresponding position, are taken as facts (REF-08, REF-14).

not_encoded.provisions: the Vienna Conventions on Diplomatic and Consular Relations
not_encoded.reason: approved scope ('out'): not cited by the Bill (REF-26).
